blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippine Coast Guard (PCG), Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP) and Philippine National Police (PNP) on Wednesday kicked off a three-day exercise in Manila to test their response to a major earthquake. The “Pagsasanay Sanlakas” will simulate a major earthquake requiring the three services to coordinate search and rescue, retrieval operations, emergency response and assistance to affected communities, the PCG said. Running from Sept. 30 to Oct. 2, the exercise will be held at the PCG National Headquarters and designated areas in Manila.
